correctness.rationale: Fresh k-with-replacement picks from each remaining ordered set yield independent rank coordinates J_m with survival ((m−j)/m)^k. An adjacent descent occurs exactly for J_(m−1)<J_m. This gives the exact p_(m,k) formula and 1-dependence. The power-increment identity 2Σr^k Δr=m^(2k)−ΣΔr² and strict increase of Δr for k≥2 prove p_(m,k)<1/2, while k=1 gives equality. Fixed-k power sums yield p_m=1/2−[k(k−1)/(2(2k−1))]/m+O_k(m⁻²), hence logarithmic mean deficit. Coupling J_m=ceil(mY_m) with i.i.d. minimum-of-k uniforms yields at most 4k/(m−1) expected descent-indicator mismatches and W1 ≤4kH_(n−1); the mean gap gives matching Ω(logn). Adjacent covariance controls variance n/12+O_k(logn), and coupling plus the classical Eulerian 1-dependent CLT gives normality. Independent exact rational weighted permutation enumeration checked 20 pairs n=2..6,k=1..4; infinite limiting statements rely on proof.
